Join the party crowd!
May 2016 • Friends
This bar used to be a 'nah, let's not bother' but all that changed when they brought in a new manager

Now it's one of the best bars in the centre of town for young and old, expats and locals alike. Always a friendly crowd, some of the best tunes in the city and great drinks promotions. They also do a pretty good pizza too

Stays open late for the party crowd but equally a good place to start the evening off. And perhaps head back later. They do great deals on bottles on a Tuesday too
